item.text: The loader currently composes `StringToSliceHookFunc(",")`, which explains the regression and may also convert non-string values under mapstructure’s built-in behavior. I’m checking the test setup and Viper version behavior before replacing it with a narrowly typed hook.

I’ll add a custom decode hook that only transforms scalar strings targeting `[]string`, using `strings.Fields` so runs of Unicode whitespace collapse and empty input becomes a non-nil empty slice. Existing comma-separated origins will need their fixture expectation updated to match the new whitespace-only delimiter requirement.

The hook and coverage are in place, including checks that arrays and non-`[]string` targets pass through unchanged. I’m running the existing config package tests now, including its YAML and environment loading cases.
